recreation_brief:
1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray background (#E8E8E8).
2. Add a centered title text box at the top with text: Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) Curve. Format as bold, dark red (#B22222), large font.
3. Add a yellow circle (#FFD700) in the top-right corner containing the black number 27.
4. Add a left-aligned text block in the upper-middle section containing the following lines in order:
   - Conclusion from Previous Experiments: (bold dark red #B22222)
   - Same Model (blue #0000FF, indented)
   - Same Test Samples (blue #0000FF, indented)
   - Performance Measures (TP, TN, FP, FN) are affected by selected threshold (bold dark red #B22222)
   - There is a Confusion Matrix for each threshold (blue #0000FF)
   - Can we combine All thresholds and corresponding Confusion Matrices in one Graph? (bold dark red #B22222)
   - Solution: Use ROC Curve (blue #0000FF)
5. Add a solid black horizontal bar (#000000) spanning the full width at the bottom of the slide.
6. Optionally place a standard white mouse arrow cursor icon in the lower-right content area to match the screenshot.
